text: Closing S4.1: the work landed (8024eb1c, including the NGCanvas NPE fix, with render failures captured in tests). The one unmet acceptance item is the Linux perceptual diff of at most 0.5% at 2x. CI has no HiDPI lane, so that item moves to bd-01M3G7MFV0SHYJM1TJWN4REPZ6 (HiDPI CI lane), which now carries it. The 1x criterion is covered by the existing FX suites. Reversible: reopen if the owner wants the 2x lane to gate S4.1.
